basis: Question and reference only; no new image/clinical adjudication; no output-dependent eligibility.

categories.APPLICABLE: Source facts or queried component supported by reference.
categories.EXPLICITLY_INAPPLICABLE: Explicit negation, mutually exclusive answer to the same identified target, or explicit contraindication; absence from a list alone is insufficient.
categories.UNDETERMINED: Cannot establish applicability/exclusion; includes nonexhaustive or different target lists.

propagation: Only affirmative use of an explicitly excluded source fact counts as confirmed mispropagation; mere text mention/definition/negation is insufficient. Per-consumer indicator, no causal attribution beyond paired edit-associated transition.
reference_target_diagnostic: Separately count substitution of brain source findings for the liver/kidney target list; not a clinical noncoexistence claim.
